_1_READ_ME_FIRST: Copy this file to config.json in the same folder, then edit the values below. config.json is gitignored on purpose: every path in it is specific to one machine, so it is never shared between computers. A fresh clone has no config.json and will not start until you create one from this file.
_2_ffmpeg: LEAVE THIS EMPTY unless autodetection fails. On startup the server looks for ffmpeg on PATH and in the usual Windows install locations, and prints where it found it. Only put a path here if it reports finding nothing. Never paste a path containing <angle brackets> - those are placeholders, and a half-replaced one is the most common cause of '[WinError 2] The system cannot find the file specified' when preparing a window.
_3_session_roots: Folders that CONTAIN the day-stamped folders (30062026, 02062026, ...). Point at the PARENT, not at a day folder itself, or the session scan finds nothing. Leave the list empty if you only upload files through the browser - uploading does not use this.
_4_export_root: Default output folder for exported clips. Can also be changed in the page itself.
_5_pipeline: Folder holding extract_session_clip.py. Needed ONLY for export. Preparing windows, both lag estimates and everything else work without it, so '.' is fine until you need export.
_6_cache_dir: Scratch space for prepared windows (~100 MB each). Leave empty to use the system temp folder. Set it to a drive with room if temp is tight. Never point it inside a OneDrive-synced folder.
_7_preview: A prepared window transcodes small upright lens videos and pre-renders LiDAR frames either side of it, so moving the lag slider costs nothing. lag_pad_s is how far beyond the window LiDAR is rendered, which caps how far the slider can travel.
